name: Major Fireball Rune

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-09: Killer in the Golden Mask

disable: DC 28 Thievery check (expert) to erase the rune without triggering the sensor, or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 26) to counteract the rune

items.name: Fireball
items.text:
Trigger A living creature enters the sensor area

---

Effect The rune detonates a fireball centered on the triggering creature's square. This is a 5th-rank Fireball spell that deals 10d6 fire damage (DC 28 basic Reflex save).

text: An invisible rune creates an invisible, spherical magical sensor with a 20-foot radius.
